rawContent: @T3Sally @scrapegroat Really??!? In these litigious, post-#MeToo times? I get they can't afford to incentivise people not bothering to pack their kit, but it still feels a bit dodgy to me.
@burnunit @JoyceCarolOates How is it acceptable to straightforwardly celebrate the achievements of an unrepentant rapist in the post-#MeToo era?

Why is it still so common, in the post-#MeToo era, to praise Mike Tyson without alluding to the whole "unrepentant convicted rapist" thing? Or worse, to treat his latter day incarnation as a sort of camp hero, ironic cameos and all, like Adam West? Inquiring minds want to know.

"But Starmer took the knee for #BLM!" As it goes, I have mixed feelings about the wisdom (but not the moral rectitude) of him doing that. But it was five seconds out of his day, hardly comparable to making a special trip to join a picket line for God knows how long.
